description.value:
Requirement bio-attuned

Duration constant

Your body's stopped complaining about what it costs to run.

Straining Load's doubled food and water requirement no longer applies to you, and you're immune to the sickened condition from a Graft check's ordinary Failure result.

cinderfall.incomplete: BAND-GAP (doubled requirement isn't modeled) stacked on a narrow condition-immunity scope Immunity doesn't support.
